description_en: Modifies the type of a snapshot. You can call this operation to convert a standard snapshot to an archived snapshot
description_zh: 修改快照类型,可以通过该接口将标准快照转换为归档快照
kebab_example: aliyun ecs modify-snapshot-category --snapshot-id s-12300sd --category Archive --retention-days 100 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySnapshotCategory

parameters.name: category

parameters.description_en:
The number of days for which the snapshot is retained. The retention period starts from the snapshot creation time (CreationTime). A standard snapshot can be archived only after it has been retained for at least 14 days since its creation.

Archived snapshots must be retained for at least 60 days. When calculating the retention period of an archived snapshot, the time already retained as a standard snapshot is deducted. If an archived snapshot is deleted before 60 days, you are charged for 60 days of archive storage. For more information, see [Snapshot billing](~~56159~~).

Valid values: [74, 65536].

>If you do not specify this parameter, the snapshot is permanently retained.
parameters.description_zh:
快照保留天数。起始时间为快照资源创建时间CreationTime。标准快照创建完成之后，必须至少已保留 14 天，才能进行归档。

归档类型快照有保留时间限制，需要在归档类型中至少保留60天。计算归档快照保留时间时，需扣除标准快照已保留时间。不足60天删除归档快照会收取60天的归档存储费用，请参见[快照计费](~~56159~~)。

取值范围[74，65536]

>不填写该参数则表示永久保留。
